meta.note: Validator, dimension and successor expectations are hand-derived. Digest cases carry their preimage; expect = SHA-256(preimage), auditable with an external sha256sum. preimage/tms-minimal-hand-built was written by hand and matched byte for byte. The toy TFK is a mass on a linear spring with motion confined to z = 0 (C_NOZ carries UNIT m from schema 0.3.0); under schema 0.4.0 every zone digest moved once more, by the version tag; the spring with its forms adds a DOF t, an entry E_t and the declared forms (increment 8). Both are test fixtures, not physics under research. Both residences MUST reproduce every expect. 0.4.1 (S15) adds, and changes no earlier case: a DIMENSION whose repeated bases sum past -9999..9999 is refused, its canonical form lying outside the grammar; the canonical token is bounded to four digits; no admitted zone's digest moves. 0.5.0 (schema 0.5.0; D176.1, D177.1): ROLE on every LAW (required) and ROLE INPUT on a DOF (optional); the TPK PARAMETERS part with D_VARIABLES ONE or SEVERAL, ONE when absent and serialized ONE; STRUCTURE_CHECK in the TMS PARAMETERS, ON when absent and serialized ON; T1's D-variable rules. Every zone digest moved once, by the version tag and the new fields; every fixture LAW carries a ROLE chosen by its physics. 0.5.1 (S33, 2026-09-26): a LAW restating the motion of a FIXed DOF (the toy's and the spring's FREE_Z, corner_fix_t's EOM_Z) carries ROLE CONSTRAINT, not EOM(z); the toy's and the spring's D(TPK) and D(TFK) move once more; successor/s050-law-role-changed now changes FREE_Z back to EOM(z). No other answer moves. 0.5.2 (C-MS-5, increment 11, 2026-09-28): 34 decode/ cases, each a JSON {} where a list is read, a JSON [] where an object is read, an object keyed 0 read as a list, or a valid empty object; TPC-PHP now reads the JSON as written (tpc_zone 0.5.1). No earlier answer moves.
